title: Who may spend credit and run the Sales credit tools
question: Should only company super admins and Sales approve visual projects on the credit model, overriding regional and allowlist auto-approval? Should Sales access come from a system role, an email allowlist file, or a catalog permission? How should service-to-service credit calls prove who they are?
context: Visual approval is limited to super admins and Sales (BILL-REQ-007), which changes PROJ-REQ-004's auto-approval for visual projects. Intent changes are Sales-only (BILL-REQ-009).
